description: Explains how to check a domain on the Spamhaus Domain Block List by hand at https://check.spamhaus.org. Does not query the Spamhaus DBL (it needs a paid key) and never returns a listing verdict: the result states that nothing was checked, gives Spamhaus's own lookup, and names the blocklist checks this server does run (check_surbl, check_blacklist).
name: spamhaus_dbl_guidance
title: Spamhaus DBL guidance (not queried)
